author: assistant-drafted, pending operator verification
constraints: The plot count is between 1 and ten thousand.
edge_cases: Leaving every plot empty is itself a valid arrangement and is counted. The two sides are independent, so the total is the count for one side multiplied by itself.
input_semantics: One parameter, n, the number of plots on each side of the street.
load_bearing: The adjacency restriction applies only within a side, never across the street. Both sides are counted together. The result is reduced modulo 1000000007 rather than reported exactly.
method_behaviour: The method accepts the plot count and returns one integer already reduced by the modulus. It does not print.
objective: Count the arrangements of houses along both sides of a street when no two houses on the same side may sit on neighbouring plots.
output_semantics: A single integer, the number of arrangements reduced modulo 1000000007.
required_operation: The street has n plots on each side, facing each other. A plot may hold a house or stay empty. Two houses on the same side may not occupy adjacent plots. A house on one side places no restriction on the plot opposite it. Count every distinct arrangement across both sides and report that count reduced modulo one thousand million and seven.
